```{=html}
<style>
  /* Scoped to the 404 page only. Colors come from the theme (light + dark). */
  .e404 {
    --e-ink:    var(--bs-body-color, #22282b);
    --e-soft:   color-mix(in srgb, var(--bs-body-color) 70%, var(--bs-body-bg));
    --e-accent: var(--bs-link-color, #a8323f);
    --e-line:   var(--bs-border-color, #ddd5c6);
    --e-bg:     var(--bs-body-bg, #f4f1ea);
    max-width: 760px; margin: 3rem auto 4rem; text-align: left;
  }
  .e404 .e-kicker {
    font-family: var(--bs-font-monospace, monospace); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--e-accent);
  }
  .e404 .e-head {
    font-family: var(--bs-font-monospace, monospace); font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
    line-height: 1.1; color: var(--e-ink); margin: .6rem 0 1rem;
  }
  .e404 .e-head code { color: var(--e-accent) !important; background: none; padding: 0; font-size: inherit; }
  .e404 p { color: var(--e-soft); max-width: 60ch; }
  .e404 figure { margin: 2rem 0 1.5rem; padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem .75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--e-line); border-radius: 4px; }
  .e404 svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
  .e404 figcaption { font-family: var(--bs-font-monospace, monospace); font-size: .75rem;
    color: var(--e-soft); margin-top: .5rem; }
  .e404 .e-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .75rem; margin-top: 1.75rem; }
  .e404 .e-actions a {
    font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; padding: .6rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 4px;
    border: 1px solid var(--e-accent);
  }
  /* !important needed: custom_styles.scss forces all links to $link-color */
  .e404 .e-actions a.e-primary { background: var(--e-accent); color: var(--e-bg) !important; }
  .e404 .e-actions a.e-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--e-accent) !important; }
  .e404 .e-actions a:hover { opacity: .88; }
</style>

<div class="e404">
  <span class="e-kicker">Error 404 · Page not found</span>
  <div class="e-head">This URL returned <code>NA</code>.</div>
  <p>The page you're looking for doesn't exist. It may have moved during a site update, or there's a typo in the address. The search icon in the top-right corner can help you find it.</p>

  <figure>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 640 240" role="img" aria-label="A line chart of pages found that ends abruptly in a gap labelled NA at this URL">
      <!-- gridlines -->
      <g stroke="var(--e-line)" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="40" y1="40"  x2="620" y2="40"/>
        <line x1="40" y1="100" x2="620" y2="100"/>
        <line x1="40" y1="160" x2="620" y2="160"/>
      </g>
      <line x1="40" y1="200" x2="620" y2="200" stroke="var(--e-soft)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <!-- observed series -->
      <polyline fill="none" stroke="var(--e-ink)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
        points="40,170 100,150 160,158 220,122 280,130 340,98 400,104"/>
      <g fill="var(--e-bg)" stroke="var(--e-ink)" stroke-width="2">
        <circle cx="40" cy="170" r="4"/><circle cx="100" cy="150" r="4"/><circle cx="160" cy="158" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="220" cy="122" r="4"/><circle cx="280" cy="130" r="4"/><circle cx="340" cy="98" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="400" cy="104" r="4"/>
      </g>
      <!-- the gap -->
      <rect x="440" y="28" width="120" height="172" fill="var(--e-accent)" opacity=".08"/>
      <line x1="500" y1="28" x2="500" y2="200" stroke="var(--e-accent)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 5"/>
      <text x="500" y="20" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="var(--e-accent)">NA</text>
      <text x="500" y="222" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace" font-size="12" fill="var(--e-accent)">this URL</text>
      <text x="40" y="222" font-family="monospace" font-size="12" fill="var(--e-soft)">pages that exist</text>
    </svg>
    <figcaption>Figure 404. Pages found, by URL. One observation is missing.</figcaption>
  </figure>

  <div class="e-actions">
    <a class="e-primary" href="/">Back to home</a>
    <a class="e-secondary" href="/data_visualizations.html">Browse the visualizations</a>
    <a class="e-secondary" href="/projects.html">View projects</a>
  </div>

  <p style="margin-top:1.75rem;font-size:.9rem;">Think something's broken? <a href="mailto:steven_ponce@yahoo.com">Let me know</a>.</p>
</div>
```
